title.value: Run marketing research, content and campaigns with Claude

introduction.value:
Marketers use Claude Code for competitive analysis, blog drafts, landing pages and HubSpot setup, and Cowork for a team that watches social channels and drafts brand-voice replies.
·

method.value: In the thread, marketers describe two main setups. One uses Claude Code to run competitive analysis, positioning research, blog drafts, and automations such as turning a webinar title and abstract into landing pages, loading emails into a marketing automation tool, setting up HubSpot campaigns, and converting a project plan into Linear issues. Another built a local app around Claude Opus that ingests brand guides, scrapes a company site and Meta Ad Library into JSON, processes Instagram examples, and generates a reusable brand bible and monthly ad concepts, with the person reviewing each step and handling design manually.

outcome.value: They report real time savings: one says the Linear workflow alone saves about an hour of repetitive setup, and the designer says it saves a few hours per client on the boring parts. Limits showed up in visuals and scale: Claude's visual guidance was ignored as weak, Cowork was called too slow by one commenter, and another said thorough Cowork analysis of about two companies used up the limit.

notes.value: One commenter put the custom app's API spend at about $10-$20 max and said they stop the workflow after each stage to review and keep control.

source_text.body:
Run marketing research, content and campaigns with Claude
Marketers use Claude Code for competitive analysis, blog drafts, landing pages and HubSpot setup, and Cowork for a team that watches social channels and drafts brand-voice replies.
·
Mar 1, 2025
Done with
CC
Claude Code
CW
Claude Cowork
What they did
In the thread, marketers describe two main setups. One uses Claude Code to run competitive analysis, positioning research, blog drafts, and automations such as turning a webinar title and abstract into landing pages, loading emails into a marketing automation tool, setting up HubSpot campaigns, and converting a project plan into Linear issues. Another built a local app around Claude Opus that ingests brand guides, scrapes a company site and Meta Ad Library into JSON, processes Instagram examples, and generates a reusable brand bible and monthly ad concepts, with the person reviewing each step and handling design manually.
How it went
They report real time savings: one says the Linear workflow alone saves about an hour of repetitive setup, and the designer says it saves a few hours per client on the boring parts. Limits showed up in visuals and scale: Claude's visual guidance was ignored as weak, Cowork was called too slow by one commenter, and another said thorough Cowork analysis of about two companies used up the limit.
Worth knowing
One commenter put the custom app's API spend at about $10-$20 max and said they stop the workflow after each stage to review and keep control.
Try it yourself
with
Claude Code
Copy prompt
I do marketing for [company/product]. Research our top [number] competitors [competitor names or websites], then write a competitive analysis summary and a first-draft blog post on [topic] in our brand voice, which is [describe voice]. Save everything as files in this folder and stop when I have the analysis and the draft; before publishing or sending anything or changing any account settings, show me what you plan to do and wait for my approval.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/ClaudeAI/comments/1ruod57/any_marketers_here_using_claude_code_or_claude
